CheckTitle: Ensure S3 Bucket Policy Does Not Allow Public or Anonymous Write Access
Description: S3 bucket policies grant public or unauthenticated write permissions.
Risk: Allowing unauthenticated write access enables malicious actors to overwrite critical files, upload malware or illegal content, alter existing objects, or flood the bucket to cause massive storage charges.

Recommendation.Text: Remove public write access from bucket policies. Restrict write access explicitly to specific IAM roles, user accounts, or trusted VPC endpoints, and enforce S3 Block Public Access.
